newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The cabinet on Monday approved the proposal for Bangladesh's ratification of the convention on the prohibition of development, production, stockpiling and use of chemical weapons.
The Department of Environment has asked 1167 industries, which are polluting the environment, to set up waste treatment plant.
Sixteen Bangladeshi pilgrims died during the hajj in Saudi Arabia.
The government on Monday approved the proposal to ratify the International Labour Organisation (ILO) convention concerning equal remuneration for male and female workers for work of equal value.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina returned home on Monday from Saudi Arabia after performing hajj.
At least two persons were killed and several hundred others injured in a severe norwester which hit the eastern Sylhet district on Monday.
Bangladesh is one of the priority countries for Thailand for its overseas investment, a visiting Thai official said on Monday.
Iran has assured assistance to Bangladesh in preserving rain and surface waters and their proper use in agriculture. REUTER
